method: Raw STL slices, local inward/outward0.4 mm opening (24 round-join segments); no loss exemption. Consecutive-layer+0.2mm overlap diagnostic is NOT support simulation.
limitations: Top sloped girder terminates in a tiny near-top slice: that component fails 0.8mm erosion, explicitly retained, not exempted.
Wood-strip projection and fine plank grooves are sub0.8mm details and may be lost; component survival does not demonstrate detail reproduction.
Initial low girder edge is not a stable print base; ribs/deck underside/rails require generated support or different orientation. No fictitious real bridge piers added.
13 ribs are approximately image-counted; even spacing and model dimensions are photographic fits.
No FFF toolpath, physical print, load test or measured architectural survey.
